title: Deposit Terms for the School Nutrition Services Meal Account: Online Portal and Cafeteria Register
content:
Money reaches a School Nutrition Services Meal Account through the district's online payment portal by card or at the cafeteria register. The terms are the same for every meal status.

| Term | Value (every meal status) |
|---|---|
| Smallest online card deposit accepted (the online deposit minimum) | 10.00 USD |
| Largest single online card deposit accepted (the online deposit maximum) | 300.00 USD |
| Convenience fee the payment processor charges per online deposit; charged by the processor and never posted to the meal account | 2.60 USD |
| Deposit methods accepted at the cafeteria register | cash at the cafeteria register; check at the cafeteria register |
| Check deposits still accepted for the household after a returned check in the same school year | no |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A parent who makes an online deposit of 45.00 pays the processor 2.60 on top; the meal account is credited 45.00. An online deposit of 9.50 is below the 10.00 minimum and is not accepted, and one of 320.00 is above the 300.00 maximum.
